title: Start-up grants for new businesses
summary: Seed funding for businesses in their first year of operation.

how: Town staff design the grant program and propose its budget.
Residents comment at a public hearing on the budget.
Town Council votes on the budget that funds the grants.

evidence.claim: Incentives tip a minority of location and opening decisions

pros: Some funded start-ups open that would not have otherwise, filling empty storefronts.
cons: Paid from the Town budget, as grants of $25,000.
Many funded start-ups would have opened anyway, and funded ones close at the usual rate for new businesses.
